pub type Raw
pub enum MachineScopeKind
  None
  OneHostInference
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum MachinePhase
  Offering
  Connecting
  Checking
  AwaitingPerson
  ConsentSent
  Reconciling
  Paired
  Refused
  Cancelled
  Expired
  Uncertain
  pub const ALL: [Self; 11]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum MachineStartOutcome
  Started
  Existing
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Conflict
  Exhausted
  Expired
  pub const ALL: [Self; 8]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>

  Changed

  Failed
  pub const ALL: [Self; 9]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str

  Updated

  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str

pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 6]
pub struct MachinePreparation
  request: MachineScopeKind
  offer: MachineScopeKind
  offer_host: ::std::string::String
  normal_service_address: ::std::string::String
  binding_name: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineRequestIdentity
  epoch: ::std::string::String
  expires_ms: i64
  nonce: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineDirection
  kind: MachineScopeKind
  host: ::std::string::String
  service_address: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineAgreement
  peer_key: ::std::string::String
  check: ::std::string::String
  transcript: ::std::string::String
  semantics: ::std::string::String
  given: MachineDirection
  received: MachineDirection
pub struct MachineOperation
  id: ::std::string::String
  phase: MachinePhase
  expires_ms: i64
  reason: ::std::string::String
  agreement: ::std::option::Option<MachineAgreement>
  question_id: ::std::string::String
  revision: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineStart
  outcome: MachineStartOutcome
  operation: ::std::option::Option<MachineOperation>
  code: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineObservation
  outcome: MachineObserveOutcome
  cursor: ::std::string::String
  operation: ::std::option::Option<MachineOperation>
pub struct MachineCancellation
  outcome: MachineCancelOutcome
  operation: ::std::option::Option<MachineOperation>
pub struct MachineRecord
  peer_key: ::std::string::String
  state: ::std::string::String
  service_address: ::std::string::String
  last_call_unix_ms: i64
  binding_name: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachinePage
  outcome: MachineListOutcome
  epoch: ::std::string::String
  request_expires_ms: i64
  revision: ::std::string::String
  next_cursor: ::std::string::String
  machines: ::std::vec::Vec<MachineRecord>
  local_service_address: ::std::string::String
pub struct MachineRemoval
  outcome: MachineRemoveOutcome
  revision: ::std::string::String
pub fn encode(v: &MachineStart) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineStart, Refusal>
pub trait JsonRecord: ::std::marker::Sized
  fn to_json(&self) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
  fn from_json(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: ::std::string::String
  message: ::std::string::String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait MachineControl
  type Error
  fn start_offer(&self, request: MachineRequestIdentity, invitation_address: ::std::string::String, preparation: MachinePreparation) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineStart, Self::Error>
  fn enter(&self, request: MachineRequestIdentity, code: ::std::string::String, preparation: MachinePreparation) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineStart, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, operation_id: ::std::string::String, after: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineObservation, Self::Error>
  fn cancel(&self, operation_id: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineCancellation, Self::Error>
  fn list(&self, cursor: ::std::string::String, limit: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<MachinePage, Self::Error>
  fn remove(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, peer_key: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<MachineRemoval, Self::Error>
pub struct MachineControlClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
